system.description:
Glimpses the path ahead for one person: a quick spell for the next week, or The Unfolding Path ritual reaching years ahead.

Spell. The Glimpse Ahead: secret Difficulty from Routine (6) for dramatic, life-changing events to Hard (15) for minor ones; +6 to read your own future. Reveals the most significant events of the coming week in general terms, without saying when.

Ritual. Alignment: Routine (6) Knowledge, 10 minutes. Invocation: Challenging (9) Awareness for one year ahead, Formidable (12) for five years, Hard (15) for ten; 30 minutes. Failure gives Flaw (Awareness) for a week. Unleashing: Routine (6) or higher Will.

Art of Divination — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 97.
system.resonances: The Method's resonances, plus something belonging to the subject unless they are present.
